""" with open\(path, "w", encoding="utf-8"\) as fh: fh.write\(html\) # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 3. print_summary # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def print_summary\(aggregate: dict, verbose: bool = False\) -> None: """Print a coloured terminal summary of aggregate test results.
